history.sg_progress: The role of the Office of Information and Communications Technology is to ensure that the guidance, services and procedures necessary are in place to address Microsoft 365 use. It has also provided to all entities the ability to monitor their own Microsoft 365 accounts through the Microsoft 365 usage dashboard, thereby supporting United Nation Secretariat entities in this regard. The Office sent a memo dated 9 July 2024 to all entities in which it announced the implementation of the quarterly disabling and deprovisioning of inactive Microsoft 365 accounts, and will also send automatic notifications to ICT focal points to take action in that regard before the quarterly clean-up.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration ensure that the Office of Information and Communications Technology strengthens its monitoring and reminder mechanisms to guide entities in Microsoft 365 accounts management and reduce any financial losses.
history.administration_response: The Office of Information and Communications Technology requests that this recommendation be closed. Sample email communications regarding the deprovisioning of inactive Microsoft 365 user accounts, which were previously shared with the relevant entities, have been provided to the Board of Auditors as supporting evidence. The updated lists of the inactive accounts affected were also submitted to the Board.
history.board_assessment: Given that various United Nations departments have actively addressed the audit recommendations by cleaning up redundant Microsoft 365 accounts, resulting in a significant reduction in the total number of accounts from more than 65,000 to just over 60,000, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
